hero.lead: Designing scalable distributed systems for <ai>AI</ai>-powered products.
hero.sub: Software engineer focused on system architecture: service boundaries, data flow and cloud infrastructure. I still ship the code, in TypeScript and Python.

about.p1: I'm a software engineer focused on system architecture: I define service boundaries, data flow and cloud infrastructure, then build across the stack to ship it, from APIs and data layers to the interfaces and the AI on top.
about.founding: As a founding engineer at Entropy Systems, I've shaped the architecture of our SaaS products for ISO standards auditing from day one. They're now used by ~40 client companies. I work with C-level leadership and the product team on the roadmap and architecture decisions.
about.p2: My work centers on the decisions that are hard to change later: how services talk to each other, where data lives, and how the system fails and recovers. I build them test-first (TDD) with TypeScript, Node and Python, and keep a long-running interest in document tooling and developer-facing libraries.
about.p3: Lately that means architecting AI-powered features: retrieval, LLM orchestration, provider-agnostic speech-to-text and the production plumbing that keeps them reliable.

bullets: Founding engineer: architected and delivered 3 SaaS products for ISO standards auditing, now used by ~40 client companies, in a small engineering team (3–5 engineers).
Worked directly with client companies to gather their requirements, and measured product KPIs with SQL queries and dashboards.

Co-designed the agentic architecture and agent harness on AWS Bedrock and GCP Vertex AI. Built the Bedrock agent pipelines for document processing, conversational assistants and workflow automation: ~2,000 audit documents per month and ~60% less manual review time.

Defined the service architecture and delivered it hands-on in TypeScript: React, Next.js and Vite on the frontend, Fastify, Node.js and Prisma on PostgreSQL on the backend, plus Go for internal projects.

Built the identity and access layer on Better Auth and OpenID Connect: passkeys (WebAuthn), 2FA, email verification, organization roles and invitations, OIDC single sign-on and CASL authorization, plus hardened admin sign-in (bounded sessions, rate limiting, nonce-based CSP, sign-in audit log).
Built a provider-agnostic speech-to-text (STT) engine that runs on AWS Transcribe or Google Cloud's Chirp 2 and Chirp 3 models, with no changes to the calling services.
Built the transaction handling for paid features and AI model usage on Stripe (Checkout Sessions with automatic tax, webhooks), including failure handling for those transactions.
Replaced a Puppeteer HTML-to-PDF pipeline with a Typst-based document and report generation system, cutting generation time and resource usage by ~90%.
Owned 12 distributed services across AWS and GCP with 99.9% uptime, built on event-driven and serverless patterns and performance-tested in simulated environments before each release.
Containerized services with Docker and built CI/CD pipelines that cut deployment time from ~1 hour to ~10 minutes, enabling daily releases.
Mentored engineers on the team and gave them regular feedback.
Led migration of a ~80k-line video analytics codebase from legacy JavaScript to TypeScript, reducing production runtime errors by ~30%.
Introduced Vite and esbuild into the build pipeline, cutting build time from ~3 min to ~20 s.
Gathered requirements directly from clients, and partnered with product and design teams to deliver consistent UI behavior across a complex, data-rich surveillance interface.
Led a team of 4 front-end engineers building 5 index and ETF analytics applications, setting engineering standards and driving delivery quality.
Introduced code reviews, linting and automated testing, raising test coverage from ~10% to ~70%.
Established shared component patterns and a consistent architecture across the applications.
Contributed across the stack: UI features in TypeScript and backend APIs in Python.
Built index construction and ETF analytics applications across frontend, backend and data layers.
Designed asynchronous RabbitMQ workflows ingesting ~1M market-data records per day.
Developed REST APIs and backend services in Python and Node.js on PostgreSQL and MongoDB, and wrote Go for internal index calculation projects.
Built 3 internal systems used daily by ~200 employees for registration, traceability and collaborator lifecycle management, using Python and Node.js.
Developed backend services in Java with Spring Boot.
Developed front-end interfaces and backend services to support business operations and data tracking workflows.
Deployed and operated services on Linux servers with NGINX as a reverse proxy.

projects.heading: What I build on my own

archsim.tagline: Architecture katas with an AI reviewer
bullets: A practice tool for software architecture. You take a short business problem, set the scope, select the driving characteristics and a style, draw the diagram and write the trade-offs.
An AI reviewer reads the diagram and the text, scores seven dimensions from 1 to 5, quotes the evidence for each score and names the top risk.
Provider-agnostic by design: it runs on Claude Code, OpenCode, the Anthropic API or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, including local models.
Includes a 43-page wiki, worked examples and a glossary of 120+ terms. Local and single-user, with plain files in place of a database.

blueprints.tagline: Markdown editor and software spec system
bullets: A desktop editor to write software specs in a vault of plain markdown files, with a Rust backend on Tauri.
Rich editing with slash commands, wiki-links and backlinks, Mermaid diagrams and Excalidraw drawings.
Git integration (status, commit, diff), full-text search with regex, tags and templates for new files.
